item.title: National Lottery Open Week comes to Boston Lodge
item.description: As part of National Lottery Open Week, the Ffestiniog and Welsh Highland Railways are set to offer free guided tours of Boston Lodge for visitors who bring a valid National Lottery ticket or scratch card.

item.title: Kent and East Sussex Railway becomes more sustainable with solar power
item.description: Thanks to a grant from the Ashford Borough Council, the Kent and East Sussex Railway will become more sustainable.

item.title: Bristol Railway’s 60th anniversary celebrated with special event
item.description: The Avon Valley Railway is taking people back in time this March to commemorate the 60th anniversary of the closure of the Bristol and Bath railway line.

item.title: National Grid grant to see return of locomotive
item.description: The Moseley Railway Trust has held a long-standing relationship with the National Grid over the course of many years. This partnership has included volunteering, team-building events, and a wide range of additional support.

item.title: Llangollen gears up to host the Garden Railway Festival this summer
item.description: The Llangollen Garden Railway Festival is joining forces with the LLangollen and Corwen Railway this June. Now one of the UK’s largest model railway events, the festival attracts thousands of enthusiasts and family days out alike each year.

item.title: Huddersfield communities provided Transpennine Route Upgrade feedback opportunity
item.description: Residents and businesses in Huddersfield and surrounding areas are being asked to have their say on the next stage of the Transpennine Route Upgrade (TRU), as plans for major improvements between Standedge and Gledholt are unveiled.

item.title: London Travel advice issued ahead of March upgrades
item.description: Rail users in East Anglia are being urged to plan ahead of travel this March, as Network Rail carries out major weekend engineering work on lines to and from London Liverpool Street.

item.title: Spudman teams up with London Northwestern Railway to celebrate Class 730 launch
item.description: TikTok sensation Spudman is hitting the Trent Valley Line with 730 free jacket potatoes as part of a month-long collaboration with London Northwestern Railway.

item.title: Borders Railway electrification work to begin this month
item.description: Network Rail is set to launch the first stage of electrification on the Borders Railway this week, signalling a significant move towards cleaner, more sustainable rail travel.
